description: Defines the TCPClientSocket class, a client socket implementation using TCP as transport layer, including connection management, socket options, and suspend handling.

classes.name: TCPClientSocket
classes.description: A client socket class implementing TCP transport, supporting connection, configuration, suspend handling, and data transfer.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific local address.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keepalive with specified delay.

methods.name: SetNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables Nagle's algorithm (TCP_NODELAY).

methods.name: SetBeforeConnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before connecting.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to the server asynchronously.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the socket.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer's address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used.

methods.name: WasAlpnNegotiated
methods.description: Indicates if ALPN negotiation occurred.

methods.name: GetNegotiatedProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL information.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic classification.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if the socket is ready.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels pending ReadIfReady operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket asynchronously.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Exposes the underlying socket descriptor for testing.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles suspend event to manage socket state.
